Where this work is useful

Use these criteria to check whether a diagnostic or implementation sprint is a good first move.

Angular System Audit

  • Angular product teams with legacy complexity
  • technical leads planning refactors or migrations

Frontend Stabilization

  • teams with active delivery pressure
  • products with brittle core workflows

Architecture Advisory

  • technical leads
  • product engineering teams approaching major frontend decisions

Boundaries that keep scope useful

These exclusions reduce mismatched requests and keep the work tied to frontend system outcomes.

Site-level exclusions

  • Pure visual redesigns without frontend system risk.
  • Greenfield marketing sites with no product architecture constraints.
  • Open-ended staff augmentation without a scoped outcome.

Angular System Audit

  • greenfield marketing pages
  • one-off visual redesigns

Frontend Stabilization

  • pure visual redesigns
  • isolated bug tickets without system context

Architecture Advisory

  • open-ended mentoring without a concrete system decision
  • commodity feature delivery

The first step is a narrow diagnostic.

Send the product context, system pain, timeline, and constraints. The reply can confirm fit before any larger commitment.
